summary: A 1947 Klamath Forest Protective Association lookout burned in 1987; a 30-ft steel tower moved from Sycan Butte replaced it in 1988.

facts.design: 30-ft steel tower with a low gable cab

access.note: Sources disagree. A July 2026 directory lists the site as accessible to the public; Rex's Fire Lookout Page says it is on private land with limited access. Check with ODF before visiting.

events.note: Register gives 1941 for a 41-foot first tower; other sources date the first lookout to 1947.
Klamath Forest Protective Association tower, 36 to 40 feet per sources, with about 1,100 feet of new access road.
Jack Dale was the first lookout on the new tower.
Vandalism damaged the station; a fire guard taken ill was found on the floor and survived.
Five fires were reported from this station in 1972.
Extensive vandalism damage, put at $1,400 to $1,500.
Condemned in 1987; the Forest Lookouts history says the old lookout was burned to the ground.
ODF moved a 30-ft steel tower from Sycan Butte and placed a new cab on top.
Added to the National Historic Lookout Register; registered March 31, 2003.
Listed as staffed in a July 2026 directory of standing Oregon lookouts.

corrections.why: The site had earlier lookouts (1947 per most sources, 1941 per the register). The 1988 work replaced the old lookout rather than founding the site.

resolved_conflicts.field: events: first tower date and height
resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register dates the first 41-ft tower to 1941. The Forest Lookouts history quotes 1947 Klamath newspaper and Forest Log items, and Rex's Fire Lookout Page dates first use to 1947 with a 36-ft tower. The story follows 1947 and notes the register's 1941 date.

Rex's Fire Lookout Page says the site is on private land with limited access. The July 2026 directory marks it as accessible to the public, which it defines as legal access to the site rather than to the tower. Level is set to restricted until confirmed.
Forest Lookouts quotes an item on the new tower that puts the site about six miles east of Klamath Falls. Rex's Fire Lookout Page says 3 miles east. The story gives both and does not pick one.
